## Goal
What user-visible change or defect does this PR address?

## Scope
- [ ] Fits 800 changed lines / 20 files, or has a documented exception.
- [ ] No unrelated Android, Rust, release, or CI changes.
- [ ] No binaries, secrets or credentials are committed.

## Validation
- [ ] `mobile-gate` passed on the exact PR head.
- [ ] Android compile checked if Android sources/build scripts changed.
- [ ] Rust/JNI compile checked if Rust or bridge files changed.
- [ ] Device test status is documented, not inferred from CI.

## Review escalation
- [ ] Security/identity/permissions/cryptography/release/CI/JNI safety is separately reviewed if changed.
